parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the SI base units of power are kg $m^{2}$ $s^{-3}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: All bodies radiate energy. The power P radiated by a body is given by P = kAT⁴, where T is the thermodynamic temperature of the body, A is the surface area of the body and k is a constant.
parts.text:
Determine the SI base units of k.
base units
